items.title: Jalen Hurts: IR stint not expected
items.text:
Hurts remains sidelined indefinitely due to a superficial blood clot in his calf, but the Eagles are not planning to place the Philadelphia quarterback on injured reserve, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: A.J. Brown: Expected to return for Week 6
items.text:
Brown (ankle) will likely be activated from injured reserve to play Sunday against the Jets, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Braelon Allen: Remains RB1 for Week 6
items.text:
Allen will once again operate as the Jets' primary running back for Sunday's game against the Patriots due to the absence of Breece Hall (quadriceps).

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Xavier Worthy: Operating as Chiefs' WR1
items.text:
Worthy will be the Chiefs' top wideout against the Chargers on Sunday due to the absence of Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee).

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: D'Andre Swift: Bigger workload sans Monangai
items.text:
Swift will once again absorb a heavier backfield workload after Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) was ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons, Larry Mayer of the Bears' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
